fields.Name: IT146 - SQL Pipeline Scenario Cross Products
fields.Description: The high-risk full cross products of the SQL pipeline scenario matrix (same dimensions, oracles and checks as IT143), on SQL Server and PostgreSQL: SPM2 composition × templating × MaxRows × StartRow on the mock schema with a CTE-shaped outer query (so a dependency's own CTE named like the outer one collides); SPM3 conditional parameters × composition on the core schema, including the refused missing / implicit same-name / unknown arguments; SPM4 own row cap (TOP, LIMIT, PERCENT, WITH TIES, OFFSET-FETCH, an unordered TOP) × composition × MaxRows × StartRow; SPM5 the extraction properties of every query saved. Split from IT143 to keep each bundle within its time limit. Self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every scenario of the high-risk cross products returns the rows of its plain-SQL oracle, and its extracted metadata satisfies the spec rules.
